about.title: Two chairs, one obsession with detail.
paragraphs: Fade & Blade started in a single back room with two chairs, a battered record player and a simple promise: no one leaves until it's right. Fifteen years later that promise hasn't changed — only the room got bigger.

We blend the discipline of classic barbering with the speed and edge of modern styling. Every barber on our floor is trained in-house across four hundred hours before they ever touch a paying head of hair.

items.question: Do you take walk-ins?
items.answer: Always. We keep two chairs open for walk-ins every day. Booking just guarantees your preferred barber and time slot, especially on Fridays and Saturdays.

items.question: How should I prepare for a shave?
items.answer: Just arrive with clean skin and let us do the rest. Avoid shaving for two days beforehand if you can — the razor glides better and the finish lasts longer.

items.question: Do you cut kids' hair?
items.answer: We love it. Our Father & Son service pairs two chairs side by side, and a child's first haircut is always on the house.

items.question: What products do you use?
items.answer: Small-batch pomades, clays, oils and balms — cruelty-free and made in the USA. Everything we use on you is available to take home at the counter.
